title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in BuddyPress…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in BuddyPress up to version 14.5.4. This vulnerability is due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which could allow an attacker with limited privileges to inject malicious scripts that execute in the context of other users. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity impact with potential confidentiality, integrity, and availability consequences.
